components.name: Primary button
components.description: Main local action with a soft lavender fill.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { background: #d2bdf4; color: #2c203e; padding: 11px 16px; border: 1px solid #e8d9ff38; border-radius: 9px; font: 600 11px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; transition: background-color .18s, box-shadow .18s; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #e4d3ff; box-shadow: 0 3px 17px #b795e522; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d5c3ff; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Text field
components.description: Inset editable value with quiet violet boundaries.
components.css: .ds-field { color: #bdb1c9; font: 11px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-field input { display: block; width: 100%; margin-top: 9px; padding: 10px 12px; color: #e3d7ec; background: #1d1d2a; border: 1px solid #43374e; border-radius: 8px; font: 12px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #7d628f; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d5c3ff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Current tool navigation
components.description: Marks the active settings section without overpowering the content.
components.html: Appearance
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; padding: 11px 12px; color: #a49bad; border-radius: 8px; font: 11px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color .18s, color .18s; } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item[aria-current] { color: #e0c9f7; background: #c2a5e914; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d5c3ff; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.northStar: A little stage for a little personality
narrative.overview: Tavi Studio pairs a calm, dark workspace with a lively character stage. The companion is the emotional center of the interface; controls should make it easy to shape and direct that personality without competing with it. The design voice is playful, warm, and character-led, with a soft lavender glow as its recurring accent. Keep the interface simple and stylish, with Georgia headings for warmth, DM Sans controls for clarity, and familiar interactions. Favor a human, expressive feel over a corporate geometric-font look.
keyCharacteristics: A character stage sits above a compact, organized tool deck.
Dark indigo surfaces create a quiet backdrop; lavender signals action and selection.
Warmth comes from the character, soft lighting, and tactile details—not decorative UI chrome.

rules.name: The Lavender Signal Rule
rules.body: Reserve lavender for actions, selection, focus, and a few character-led accents; do not use it as general decoration.

rules.name: The Warm Clarity Rule
rules.body: Prefer sentence case and plain language. Let the type feel conversational; avoid corporate all-caps labels, exaggerated tracking, and overly compressed text.

dos: Do keep the character as the most distinctive and visually prominent part of the studio.
Do use plain, reassuring language for connection, placement, and error states.
Do keep settings grouped by what the streamer is trying to do, with consistent controls across panels.
Do preserve keyboard focus visibility, reduced-motion support, and responsive behavior.
Do use the soft lavender glow to show a meaningful action or selected state.
donts: Don't make the interface resemble a generic corporate dashboard.
Don't add decorative gradients, badges, or cards where they do not explain hierarchy or state.
Don't make essential labels or instructions depend on tiny microcopy.
Don't use motion only for decoration; transitions should answer an interaction or clarify a state change.
